newsitem.title: INDIA: RTRS-Cricket-Australia win toss, elect to bat.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Australia win toss, elect to bat.

text.p: Australian skipper Mark Taylor, playing in his 100th one-day international, won the toss and elected to bat in the Titan Cup triangular series match against South Africa on Friday.
South Africa called in Andrew Hudson and Brian McMillan in place of Herschelle Gibbs and injured Fanie de Villiers to the side that beat India at Rajkot on Tuesday.
Australia dropped an unwell Mark Waugh from the side that played South Africa at Faridabad in the second preliminary face-off between the two teams last Thursday. Michael Slater took his place.

Teams: Mark Taylor (captain), Ricky Ponting, Steve Waugh, Stuart Law, Michael Bevan, Michael Slater, Adam Gilchrist, Brad Hogg, Damien Fleming, Glenn McGrath and Paul Reiffel. Twelfth man: Jason Gillespie.

South Africa: Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Pat Symcox, Brian McMillan, Dave Richardson, Nicky Boje, Lance Klusener and Allan Donald. Twelfth man: Derek Crookes.
